typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Member ID} as string,
		Region as string,
		{Account ID} as string,
		{Contract Effective Date} as string,
		{Product Name} as string,
		{Product Description} as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{Plan Name} as string,
		{Plan ID Number} as string,
		{Purchaser ID} as string,
		{Purchaser Name} as string,
		{Enrollment Unit ID} as string,
		{Enrollment Unit Name} as string,
		{Billing Unit ID} as string,
		{Billing Unit Name} as string,
		{Contract Enrollment/Start Date} as string,
		{Contract Enrollment/Start Reason Code} as string,
		{Contract Enrollment/Start Reason Description} as string,
		{Contract Termination/End Date} as string,
		{Contract Termination/End Reason Code} as string,
		{Contract Termination/End Reason Description} as string,
		{Contract Renewal Date} as string,
		{Product Rate} as string,
		{Current Dues} as string,
		{Future Dues} as string,
		{Dental Flag} as string,
		{Vision Flag} as string,
		{Chiropractic Flag} as string,
		{Other Option 1 Flag} as string,
		{Other Option 2 Flag} as string,
		{Rate-up Tier} as string,
		{Rate-up Factor} as string,
		{Rate-up Effective Date} as string,
		{Rate-up End Date} as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/KPWA_MemberContracts*']) ~> source1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> AddADFId
AddADFId split(isNull({Member ID})||isNull({Account ID})||isNull({Contract Effective Date})||isNull({Product Type})||isNull({Plan Name})||isNull({Purchaser ID})||isNull({Enrollment Unit ID})||isNull({Enrollment Unit Name}),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(RejectCondition, toSFDC)
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC derive({Contract Effective Date} = coalesce(toString(toDate({Contract Effective Date}, 'YYYYMMdd')), {Contract Effective Date}),
		{Contract Enrollment/Start Date} = coalesce(toString(toDate({Contract Enrollment/Start Date}, 'YYYYMMdd')), {Contract Enrollment/Start Date}),
		{Contract Termination/End Date} = coalesce(toString(toDate({Contract Termination/End Date}, 'YYYYMMdd')), {Contract Termination/End Date}),
		{Rate-up Effective Date} = coalesce(toString(toDate({Rate-up Effective Date}, 'YYYYMMdd')), {Rate-up Effective Date}),
		{Rate-up End Date} = coalesce(toString(toDate({Rate-up End Date}, 'YYYYMMdd')), {Rate-up End Date})) ~> DerivedColumn
ConditionalSplit1@RejectCondition derive(REJECT_REASON = iif(isNull({Member ID})||isNull({Account ID})||isNull({Contract Effective Date})||isNull({Product Type})||isNull({Plan Name})||isNull({Purchaser ID})||isNull({Enrollment Unit ID})||isNull({Enrollment Unit Name}), concat('ADF:REQUIRED FEILD MISSING: ', iif(isNull({Member ID}), '{Member ID} ', ''), iif(isNull({Account ID}), '{Account ID} ', ''), iif(isNull({Contract Effective Date}), '{Contract Effective Date} ', ''), iif(isNull({Product Type}), '{Product Type} ', ''), iif(isNull({Plan Name}), '{Plan Name} ', ''), iif(isNull({Purchaser ID}), '{Purchaser ID} ', ''), iif(isNull({Enrollment Unit ID}), '{Enrollment Unit ID} ', ''), iif(isNull({Enrollment Unit Name}), '{Enrollment Unit Name}.', '')), '')) ~> RejectReason
RejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
DerivedColumn select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Medical_Record_Number__c = {Member ID},
		Region_Code__c = Region,
		Family_Account_ID__c = {Account ID},
		Contract_Effective_Date__c = {Contract Effective Date},
		Plan__c = {Product Name},
		Plan_Description__c = {Product Description},
		Product_Type__c = {Product Type},
		Plan_Name__c = {Plan Name},
		Plan_ID_Number__c = {Plan ID Number},
		Purchaser_ID__c = {Purchaser ID},
		Purchaser_Name__c = {Purchaser Name},
		Enrollment_Unit_ID__c = {Enrollment Unit ID},
		Enrollment_Unit_Name__c = {Enrollment Unit Name},
		Billing_Unit_ID__c = {Billing Unit ID},
		Billing_Unit_Name__c = {Billing Unit Name},
		Contract_Enrollment_Start_Date__c = {Contract Enrollment/Start Date},
		Contract_Enrollment_Start_Reason_Code__c = {Contract Enrollment/Start Reason Code},
		Contract_Enrollment_Reason_Description__c = {Contract Enrollment/Start Reason Description},
		Contract_Termination_End_Date__c = {Contract Termination/End Date},
		Contract_Termination_Reason_Code__c = {Contract Termination/End Reason Code},
		Contract_Termination_Reason_Description__c = {Contract Termination/End Reason Description},
		Contract_Renewal_Date__c = {Contract Renewal Date},
		Product_Rate__c = {Product Rate},
		Current_Dues__c = {Current Dues},
		Future_Dues__c = {Future Dues},
		Dental_Flag__c = {Dental Flag},
		Vision_Flag__c = {Vision Flag},
		Chiropractic_Flag__c = {Chiropractic Flag},
		Other_Option_Flag_1__c = {Other Option 1 Flag},
		Other_Option_Flag_2__c = {Other Option 2 Flag},
		Rate_Up_Tier__c = {Rate-up Tier},
		Rate_Up_Factor__c = {Rate-up Factor},
		Rate_Up_Effective_Date__c = {Rate-up Effective Date},
		Rate_Up_End_Date__c = {Rate-up End Date}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select
AddADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('KPWA_MemberContracts_raw.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> IntermediateOutput
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('kpwa_MemberContracts_source_reject.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> RejectOutput
Select sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('KPWA_MemberContracts_Member_Contract__c.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> InsertMemberContracts
